_comment: PhyVolt AI — PyBaMM Simulation Configuration. All thresholds are illustrative screening values for synthetic data generation. They are NOT universal battery industry standards.

NMC.notes: NMC811/graphite, validated in Chen et al. 2020. Suitable for SPM at moderate C-rates.

NCA.notes: NCA/graphite, Kim et al. 2011. Suitable for SPM screening.

LFP.notes: LFP/graphite, Prada et al. 2013. LFP flat OCV profile; SPM approximation.

unsupported_chemistries.LTO: No validated LTO parameter set in PyBaMM 26.x. Report as unsupported.
unsupported_chemistries.LCO: No validated LCO parameter set in PyBaMM 26.x. Report as unsupported.
unsupported_chemistries.LMO: No validated LMO parameter set in PyBaMM 26.x. Report as unsupported.

pulse_test._timestamp_convention: Pulse-start sample IS included. A 120-second pulse produces 121 samples (t=0 to t=120 inclusive), 120 one-second intervals.
pulse_test.current_sign_convention: Positive current = discharge (positive I in PyBaMM discharge experiments)

dataset_generation._noise_note: No noise augmentation by default. Enable with --augment-noise flag. Uses fixed seed=42 for reproducibility.

grading._note: These are illustrative screening thresholds for synthetic data demonstration only. They do NOT constitute safety certification or industry-standard SoH criteria.

grade_A.description: Meets high-performance second-life screening criteria (pulse test only).

grade_B.description: Meets intermediate-performance criteria. Requires further evaluation before reuse decision.

grade_C.description: Does not meet second-life reuse screening criteria. Consider refurbishment review.

recycle_review.description: Resistance too high for any reuse pathway. Requires recycling assessment.

safety_quarantine.description: Safety override — takes priority over all performance grades.
safety_quarantine._note: In synthetic simulations, safety conditions are simulated scenarios, NOT real sensor measurements.

triggers._gas_note: Gas sensor thresholds apply only to LIVE HARDWARE data. Synthetic simulations cannot produce real gas readings.
